description:
Search for jobs in the STON job database. Returns structured JSON.

Call this tool ONCE per user request, then present the returned `jobs` list
to the user in whatever format fits (markdown list, table, plain text).
Always include the apply link from the `url` field for each job.
If `has_more` is true, mention `total_found` and ask whether to fetch more.
NEVER call this tool multiple times in a row to collect all pages automatically.

To count results without fetching full job data, prefer `count_jobs`. If a
filter you need isn't on `count_jobs`, call this tool with `rows=1` and read
`total_found` (the count is server-side and independent of `rows`).

Args:
    q: Search keywords (German job market — examples: "Softwareentwickler Python", "Krankenpfleger")
    location: City, region or area, e.g. "München", "Ravensburg", "Bodensee", "Baden-Württemberg"
    radius: Search radius in km around the location, e.g. 25, 50 (default: server setting)
    working_plan: One of: "Vollzeit", "Teilzeit", "Minijob", "Homeoffice" (comma-separated for multiple)
    job_offer_type: One of: "Arbeitsplatz", "Ausbildung", "Praktikum", "Freiberuflich", "Werkstudent", "Trainee", "Duales-Studium" (comma-separated for multiple)
    min_salary: Minimum ANNUAL gross salary in EUR (optional), e.g. 60000.
                Filtered server-side. Jobs advertised per month/hour are
                normalised to a yearly figure first, so e.g. 5000/month matches
                min_salary=60000. Salary ranges match on OVERLAP, not containment:
                a job advertised as 30.000–45.000 € IS returned at min_salary=40000
                (the ranges overlap), and is NOT returned at max_salary=25000.
    max_salary: Maximum annual gross salary in EUR (optional, same overlap semantics)
    has_salary: If True, return only jobs that advertise a salary at all
                (any amount); if False, only jobs without one. Leave unset to ignore.
    sort: "relevance" (default) or "date" (newest first)
    page: Page number starting at 1
    rows: Results per page, 1-50 (default: 25)

Returns:
    On success: {
        "total_found": int,
        "page": int,
        "rows": int,
        "total_pages": int,
        "has_more": bool,
        "salary_filter": null | {"min_salary": float|null, "max_salary": float|null},
        "jobs": [
            {
                "id": str, "title": str, "company_name": str,
                "location": str, "date": str (ISO-8601), "url": str,
                "salary": null | {"annual_eur": float, "monthly_eur": float, "currency": str,
                                  "min_annual_eur"?: float, "max_annual_eur"?: float,
                                  "data_quality"?: "suspect"}  # implausibly high → likely a data error
            }, ...
        ]
    }
    On error: {"error": str}
name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
